# Maximize "Ask about this video"

> A free, open-source Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that adds a maximize button to
> YouTube's "Ask about this video" AI panel, expanding it from YouTube's fixed ~456px
> column to the full width of the browser window, and raising its body text from 14px
> to 18px. It requests zero browser permissions.

Homepage: https://meherhendi.github.io/youtube-ask-maximizer/
Source: https://github.com/meherhendi/youtube-ask-maximizer
Licence: MIT
Author: Meher Hendi (https://github.com/meherhendi)
Version: 1.0.0

## Key facts

- Problem solved: YouTube's "Ask about this video" AI chat panel is fixed at roughly
  456 pixels wide with 14px text and has no built-in widening or font setting.
- Solution: a toggle button injected into the panel header, left of the Close button.
  Clicking it makes the panel span the whole browser window at 18px text. Clicking
  again, or pressing Escape, restores the default.
- Permissions: none. The manifest declares no `permissions` and no `host_permissions`.
- Network activity: none. No analytics, telemetry, tracking, storage, or remote code.
- Scope: content script limited to www.youtube.com and m.youtube.com.
- Size: about 11 KB; roughly 200 lines of JavaScript and CSS.
- Browser support: Chrome and Brave tested; any Chromium browser supporting Manifest V3
  (Edge, Opera, Vivaldi) expected to work. Firefox is not supported.
- Distribution: currently installed unpacked via chrome://extensions with Developer mode
  enabled and "Load unpacked". Not yet on the Chrome Web Store.

## Install

1. Clone or download https://github.com/meherhendi/youtube-ask-maximizer
2. Open chrome://extensions (brave://extensions, edge://extensions)
3. Enable Developer mode
4. Click "Load unpacked" and select the folder
5. Reload any open YouTube tab
